settings.avoid_honour_restore_high: Avoid honour restore when honour above
settings.content_priority_help:
Tick a type to track it; higher in the list = higher priority.
Un-tick types you don't want marked (to track only a few, un-tick the rest).
Use the arrows to reorder.
settings.follow_walkable_terrain.tooltip: On: route follows the walkable path like Radar. Off: straight lines.
settings.force_crystal_ids.tooltip: Comma/space separated crystal entity ids (read from the yellow/grey id labels). Empty = normal room route.
settings.mark_best_chests.tooltip:
In the reward room, marks the best chests on the large map. For each key
tier it highlights the top-N chests by content priority, where N = your live
Bronze/Silver/Gold key count.
settings.paint_walkable_grid: Paint Walkable Grid (where can I walk)
settings.paint_walkable_grid.tooltip: Green = cells the game marks walkable, around the player. Shows why an A* leg goes straight (player on a non-walkable cell).
settings.room_id_gap.tooltip: Crystals of one room share contiguous entity ids; a larger gap = another room. Only the player's room is routed.
settings.room_margin.tooltip: Route shows only when the player is within the crystal room's bounding box + this margin. Prevents it appearing from an adjacent room.
settings.show_crystals.tooltip: Death-crystal (HourglassLethal) collection route + markers on the map overlay.
settings.show_levers.tooltip: Mark the un-activated Sanctum lever on the large map. Removed once pulled.
settings.show_portals.tooltip: Mark ACTIVE hazard Portals on the large map. Removed once a portal closes.
settings.weights_help: Higher = more desirable. Drag to adjust (Ctrl+click to type). Saved to config.
